bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to reconstruct the platform, base, and supporting structure for the Hermann the German statue in New Ulm.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; HERMANN THE GERMAN STATUE SUPPORTS. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the city of New Ulm to reconstruct the platform, base, and supporting structure of the Hermann the German monument in New Ulm. This appropriation may also be used to demolish the old platform, base, and supporting structure. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to reconstruct the platform, base, and supporting structure for the Hermann the German statue in New Ulm.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; HERMANN THE GERMAN STATUE SUPPORTS.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the city of New Ulm to reconstruct the platform, base, and supporting structure of the Hermann the German monument in New Ulm. This appropriation may also be used to demolish the old platform, base, and supporting structure.
